title: “Expulsion should never be the price of a peaceful protest,” he said.

ai.summary: Former Kerala High Court Judge Justice K Babu stated that peaceful student protests are integral to constitutional democracy, not the 'grammar of anarchy', emphasizing the right to protest cannot be abolished for students.

facts.claim: peaceful dharna is not the grammar of anarchy
facts.quote: A peaceful dharna is not the grammar of anarchy. It is the grammar of Article 19,

facts.claim: students must have the right to protest peacefully
facts.quote: With the deepest respect, I wish to submit why I believe that students must have the right to protest peacefully if our democracy is to remain fruitful,

facts.claim: the right to peaceful protest cannot be abolished
facts.quote: The right itself cannot be abolished, and certainly not for an entire class of citizens because they happen to be students,

ai.background_note: Former Kerala High Court Judge Justice K Babu argued that peaceful student protests are constitutional and necessary for democracy, countering a Kerala High Court observation that political activities like dharna have no place in academic institutions.
